payload.description_html: Giraffatitan was formerly considered a species within the Brachiosaurus genus, but was given distinct status based on studies between 1991 and 2009. Giraffatitan was larger than its more famous North American counterpart at approximately 25 m in total body length, with the characteristic vertical posture supported by its proportionately long front legs.
